independentReview:
# Presenter pixels visual critique

Inspected only `presenter.png` and `reference.png` from the supplied capture set.

**Verdict: no concrete presentation defect visible. High confidence for framing and aspect ratio; medium confidence for the smallest text.**

- All four desktop boundaries are present: top menu bar, left desktop/sidebar edge, right browser edge and controls, and bottom dock/background edge. No visibly cropped screen edge.
- The desktop keeps the reference's proportions. Dock icons, window controls, and circular icons show no apparent stretch. Narrow, balanced side margins are appropriate for the player window; its header sits above the desktop.
- Main labels, browser/sidebar landmarks, dock icons, page count, and right-side actions remain readable or recognizable at the supplied player size. Footer/legal text is small but not conspicuously damaged relative to the reduced frame size.
- The large white document panes are also present in the reference. They do not visibly replace missing desktop content. Their heights/scroll position differ between the captures, and the candidate contains a cursor highlight; these differences do not establish a presentation failure from these stills.

No fixes recommended from this capture set. This assessment concerns visible geometry and content only, not decode timing or exact pixel parity.
